Name: (CP) Transboy Alex
Author: noxxsairconditioner
Description:
I've never made a mod before so sorry if this is broken :p I just wanted practice with Content Patcher in preparation for a larger mod and I love the idea of transmasc Alex sm <3

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bNXWC1qC/description.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Tweaks Alex's sprites (and portraits!) to show top surgery scars or a chest binder, plus optionally phallo scars on his arm! [/size][/color]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DyVHj17p/installation-instructions.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Add to mods folder like any other Content Patcher mod.[/size][/color]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qMfSb2p5/main-features.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]By default adds top surgery scars to Alex's shirtless sprites, like when lifting weights or at the beach. Optionally this can be switched for a chest binder, which will appear on his shirtless portrait as well. Also includes toggleable phallo scars for either one :][/size][/color]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yYqtQ07r/requirements.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Requires content patcher. Generic mod config menu highly recommended + basically necessary unless you just want the top surgery scars. Or you can edit the config.json by hand if you really want to lol.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod will conflict with any other mod that affects Alex's sprites/portraits obv.[/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Transboy Alex
Manifest.Description: Small, highly configurable mod to tweak Alex portraits/sprites to appear transmasc. Options for top surgery & phallo scars as well as a chest binder! :].
